target_customer: Retailers and consumer brands, including enterprise retailers and sellers on Amazon and Shopify, that set prices across channels
problem: Retail pricing teams decide in spreadsheets with cost-plus targets and leave revenue and margin on the table.
business_model: B2B SaaS pricing co-pilot (pricing terms not found)

founders.name: Tanvi Surti
founders.background_notes: YC page: a decade building product teams at Uber and Microsoft; led the Uber pricing team (UberPool pricing per TechCrunch). Education not listed.

founders.name: Yonah Mann
founders.background_notes: YC page: led pricing teams at Uber Eats. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Pricefx
competitors.what: Algorithmic pricing software, mainly for software-as-a-service and B2B businesses
competitors.funding_then: TechCrunch says it raised tens of millions

competitors.name: Fetcherr
competitors.what: Dynamic airfare pricing for airlines, an adjacent pricing AI player
competitors.funding_then: TechCrunch says it recently raised $12.5 million in equity

technical_complexity.rationale: Demand modeling and price recommendations need data science plus integrations with Amazon and Shopify and enterprise retail data. Founders had run pricing systems at Uber, which lowered the execution risk for a six person team.

defensibility.rationale: Pricing models trained on a retailer's own data could create some lock-in, but with eight brands as customers at seed time and established vendors in the space, copying by incumbents or newer AI entrants was plausible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying Luca. A July 2024 press release shows grocer Good Eggs using it, so it was still selling more than a year after the seed.

market_need_then: Retail pricing was described by the founders as spreadsheet driven. TechCrunch reported eight brands using the platform and two Fortune 500 retailers in pilot design in April 2023.

branding.domain_note: Used askluca.com rather than luca.com, so a prefix domain. The domain showed a Plesk default hosting page when fetched in this research.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned as an AI co-pilot for retail operators

brand_strength.rationale: The co-pilot framing was clear in the YC launch post and TechCrunch, but no mascot, community or brand press was found, and many unrelated companies and a film share the name Luca.

outcome_analysis: Luca had unusually strong founder market fit, with both founders from Uber pricing, and closed a $2.5M seed led by Menlo Ventures in April 2023, about four months after the Winter 2023 batch. It had eight brand customers and enterprise pilots and was still announcing customers in July 2024. The YC directory later lists it as inactive and the askluca.com domain now shows a generic hosting page, but no source states why, so the cause is not public.
notes: The seed is confirmed by TechCrunch plus several outlets and a Menlo post. A CB Insights comparison page shows an ambiguous Acquired label that is not tied to Luca and is not used. Revionics and Competera appear as incumbents in later comparison pages but no source dated near the batch was opened, so they are not in the competitor list. Exit type unknown because YC status is Inactive without any shutdown source.
